recipes.name: Chocolate Caramel Nut Cheesecake
ingredients_raw: 2 (2.16 ounce) bars chocolate-coated caramel-peanut nougat candy, chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a small bowl, combine the melted butter, graham cracker crumbs and 1 tablespoon sugar. Press into the bottom of a 9 inch springform pan. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes. Allow to cool.
In a large bowl, cream the 3/4 cup of sugar and cream cheese together until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time, and vanilla. Stir in chopped candy bar, and pour into baked crust.
Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 45 minutes. Let cool and carefully remove the springform pans side.

raw_recipe.headline: Chocolate Caramel Nut Cheesecake
raw_recipe.description: Chunks of candy bar add a delightful element to this cheesecake. My entire family likes it!

review.reviewBody: This cheesecake is absolutely marvelous! One of the reviewers (KIMAR) had trouble making the crust. She thought the ratio of crumbs to butter was off. I think her oven was off. I have made this numerious times and NEVER had a problem with the crust. To the reviewer who said they had a problem with the top cracking, this happens with most cheescakes that get overbaked. Always watch your cheesecake when there is 5-10 minutes left in the baking process. Cheesecake is done when the center is set (sort of looks like Jello). Overall, this recipe is terrific on ease & taste. I don't think KIMAR knows the first thing in baking cheesecakes. It takes a lot of practice. And this one is a great one to start with! I also followed other people's reviews and garnished with chocolate and caramel sauce. I then sliced snickers and placed them around the edge! What a professional look! Thanks so much for this great recipe!

This was delicious! I wanted a thicker cheesecake so I added an extra package of cream cheese and an extra egg, extra 1/4 cup sugar, a bit more chopped Snickers bar to compensate. My 9 inch springform had broken during our move a couple months ago, so I had to use an 8 inch. It made a very tall, but lovely, cheesecake. Just had to bake it about 20 minutes longer. Left it in the oven for about 2 hours after I turned it off. Garnished with mini Snickers bars and Praline Sundae Topping from this site. Very delicious, and a great dessert for Thanksgiving!

Great recipe. I did use 5 tablespoons of butter to make the crust. I also used 2 chopped Snickers bars in the batter and chopped one for the top. Drizzled some carmel and chocolate syrup just before serving. Everyone loved it!

This was a great and easy recipe- and the first cheesecake that I ever made. They don't sell graham crackers here in Chile, so I substituted chocolate cookies and took advantage of the availability of manjar (dulce de leche) to make the design on the top. The cake only cracked a little bit where the manjar was, probably because I didn't use a bath for lack of another pan. I put some more manjar on the plate before serving to jazz it up a bit. Overall, delicious!

This was one of 2 cheesecakes I made for Easter. This was my first-ever baked cheesecake and it cracked badly. To hide it I frosted it by mixing 6 melted Baker's chocolate squares and 1/2 a cup of light sour cream. I then garnished the edge with cut dark chocolate Snickers pieces. I had added candy pieces also to the batter and used an Oreo crust instead of graham crackers. It looked great once frosted and was a HUGE hit, especially with the kids! I also used dental floss to cut it after overnight refrigeration. Worked wonderfully! I will make this again and again!

This cheesecake was terrific!Very smooth and creamy. We used 3 snickers bars and chopped one up to put on the top when there was about 5 minutes left of cooking time.We did add 2 tbs of extra butter(seemed very dry) and the crust turned out great.Also,we used 1 bar of 'light'cream cheese.We thought it would be a very sweet cheesecake,but were surprised it wasn't..it was perfect! Give it a try:)

Excellent recipe! I made it for my boyfriends birthday - what a hit! I forgot the sugar for the crust, but it still came out fine. I used Snickers bars - I put two in with the mix and sliced another one to put on top (like in the picture). I used Smucker's caramel ice cream topping and drizzled it over the top. Nothing but rave reviews from everyone there (and there definitely no leftovers).

this cheescake was the best i have ever made!!! i got sooo many compliments i cant describe how happy i was! this is soooo delicious i couldnt believe i made it with my own hands! i added a chocolate and walnuts layer before a added the cream cheese mixture, and then i made a chocolate candy, caramel and walnuts topping! it came out fantasticly delicious!! this is a dream cheescake,! i was told this is a "uo for competition" recipe. wow! totaly recommend it! 10 stars!

Great Recipe...with about 5 minutes to go, i turned off the heat and let the cheescake cool in the oven as suggested elsewhere in this site. It worked great, with no cracking at all. Garnished the top with some additional Snickers Pieces and swirled caramel and chocolate syrup on top. Thanks for the great idea!

Easy and cake tasted great. My snickers either sunk or disappeared. I can’t find them. LOL. I didn’t have an issue with the crust ratio ingredients. I made it as written. My cake cracked but I spooned salted caramel topping over the cake and decorated with chopped snickers. Family liked this one.
This recipe is great! Instead of using chocolate caramel candies I used homemade caramel and semisweet chocolate. Everyone loved it and asked for seconds and even thirds.
ok
this is amazing!!!
I made this cake with Twix. My family loved this cake. So I will definitely share this recipe with my friends and of course will make again :)
Havent tried it yet ....definately going to and am going to use snickers in the recipe and chopped ontop with the caramel sauce...looks so good...but was wondering ...do u need the spring pan?

Was very easy to make. I made a oreo crust. Cake did crack, very disappointing. Was very creamy. Chopped Snickers all floated to the bottom. Can anyone tell me how to avoid that for future cakes? Thanks for the recipe, will try again.
Absolutely wonderful. The first cheesecake I have ever made and it was fabulous. Thank you for the recipe. Very easy to make and put together.

I didn't even let it bake the full amount of time called for, and I still over baked it. Next time I'll try letting it bake even shorter. Can't really give it an accurate number of stars 'cause I don't know how it would've been.
Simply and nice and taste great with the caramel and Snicker bar on top as in the photo

Wow! I'm not a big cheesecake fan, but this recipe could very well make me one. It's incredibly easy and tastes great. First cheesecake I ever made, and I'll be making this again a lot! Followed recipe as is and topped with whipped cream and chocolate syrup. It's tooooo good!
